function.name: obsidian_cli
function.description: Execute an Obsidian CLI command to read, create, search, or modify notes and vault data.

command.description: The primary Obsidian CLI command (e.g., read, create, append, daily:append, search, tasks, property:set, plugin:reload)

args.description: Key-value parameters for the command (e.g. { "path": "notes/meeting.md", "content": "text", "query": "search term" })

vault.description: Optional vault name if targeting a specific vault
